verdict.rationale: No evidence of a versioned API contract or documented deprecation policy; the evidence pack covers pipeline features, CLI, MCP server, and ecosystem integrations but nothing about API versioning guarantees or deprecation timelines. An OpenAPI spec probe even returned 404s, further indicating no formal API contract documentation. Missing for 10: any versioning scheme documentation, deprecation notice policy, changelog/breaking-change process, or SemVer commitments.
